t: Titan TTB1363MSW 210mm sliding mitre saw delivers precise cross and bevel cuts in various wood types. The corded power tool is suitable for kitchen fitters, deck builders and general joiners working on site. A powerful 1500W motor drives the 210mm TCT blade to handle tough timber easily. Features dual extendable side tables to stabilse longer workpieces, improving cutting accuracy, and a smooth sliding mechanism which extends the cutting width up to 310mm for wider boards. Ideal for for shelving, deck boards and wider timber. Built on a durable aluminium base, it provides a stable platform for accurate woodworking tasks. Equipped with a carry handle.
